title.en: The Diesel Concrete Sprayer Is Not the Diesel 30 Trailer
title.zh: 柴油混凝土喷涂机不是柴油30拖泵

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints a diesel concrete sprayer at 28/32 HP, 5 m³/h and particle ≤6 mm. Diesel 30 is a trailer pump at 56 kW and 15 m³/h. The shared word “diesel” is not the order.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把柴油混凝土喷涂机印成 28/32 HP、5 m³/h、粒径 ≤6 mm。柴油30是 56 kW、15 m³/h 的拖泵。共同的“柴油”两个字不是订单。

h1.en: Split the Diesel Sprayer from Diesel 30 Before You Inquire
h1.zh: 询盘前把柴油喷涂机和柴油30分开

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists the diesel concrete spraying machine at 28/32 HP, 5 m³/h, 8 MPa, 80 m / 40 m, hose 38/51 mm and particle ≤6 mm. The product record also prints 480 kg on the comparison line with Type 511 diesel. Diesel 30 prints 4105 / 56 kW, 15 m³/h, 20 MPa, 60 m / 180 m and 2000 kg. If the purchase is spraying without 380 V at 5 m³/h and ≤6 mm, open the sprayer. If the purchase is a trailer, open [/en/products/diesel-30-concrete-pump/](/en/products/diesel-30-concrete-pump/). Both are quote or inquiry paths with no printed price.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械（邢台）把柴油混凝土喷涂机列为 28/32 HP、5 m³/h、8 MPa、80 m / 40 m、软管 38/51 mm、粒径 ≤6 mm。与 511 柴油机对照的产品记录还写了 480 kg。柴油30印 4105 / 56 kW、15 m³/h、20 MPa、60 m / 180 m、2000 kg。如果采购的是无 380 V、5 m³/h、≤6 mm 的喷涂，打开喷涂机。如果采购的是拖泵，打开 [/zh/products/diesel-30-concrete-pump/](/zh/products/diesel-30-concrete-pump/)。两者都是询价路径，没有印出的价格。

body.en: 28/32 HP is the sprayer’s engine line. Diesel 30 uses kilowatts, 56 kW. Do not write HP onto the trailer order.
body.zh: 28/32 HP 是喷涂机的发动机行。柴油30用千瓦，56 kW。不要把马力写进拖泵订单。

body.en: ≤6 mm is the sprayer particle. Diesel 30’s aggregate cell is 3 cm and below, with a description note of 1 cm beside the distance. They are not one stone size.
body.zh: ≤6 mm 是喷涂机粒径。柴油30的骨料格是 3 cm 及以下，说明里又在距离旁标注 1 cm。这不是同一种石子尺寸。

heading.en: Send the family in the first word

body.en: Write “sprayer” or “trailer” plus the path, to [/en/contact/](/en/contact/).
body.zh: 写上“喷涂机”或“拖泵”以及路径，发到 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/)。

question.en: Is 5 m³/h also the hydraulic sprayer?
question.zh: 5 m³/h 也是液压喷涂机吗？

answer.en: The 380 V hydraulic page prints 5 m³/h as well, with 7.5/9 kW and ≤8 mm. Different path.
answer.zh: 380 V 液压页也印 5 m³/h，但是 7.5/9 kW、≤8 mm。路径不同。
